experiments.title: 5,000-step requested uniform versus frozen fit4_plus
experiments.decision: Uniform averages 81.71% versus 81.11% for fit4_plus (−0.60 pp for weighting). Uniform also has lower mean NLL. Retain uniform as the stronger control in this comparison; no demonstrated fit4_plus benefit.
experiments.protocol: Fresh starts; three paired seeds 20261026/27/28; fixed 5,000-step cosine schedule. Same frozen 5k teacher pool, requested labels, balanced 5k real subset and ResNet18 recipe. One arm per T4, run concurrently. All six trajectories reached 5,000 successful updates with zero AMP skips; all training/evaluation exits 0. Controller wall 18.39 minutes. Final evaluation on all 5,000 D_val images; historically exposed D_val, V_report now opened. D_test/C_risk untouched.

experiments.title: Trial 2 progressive step reduction
experiments.decision: Verified: retain the eight-step student (93.45% independent accuracy, 85% worst class, FID 28.53). Four-step compression failed quality and recall gates; stop before two or one steps. Trial 2 exited 0; the shared notebook is ERROR because Trial 3 failed.
experiments.protocol: One generator training seed; 8-step stage 1,000 updates after the sole predefined extension, 4-step stage 500 updates. Fresh 2k balanced samples / 5k D_val, Inception-v3 FP32; real-real FID 20.08 on disjoint 2.5k halves. 8-step generation 106.64s versus 211.91s for the 16-step teacher, batch 32. All gates and tensors audited. Public teacher may have seen D_val; C_risk/D_test unused. Three-seed confirmation remains pending; historical FID counts differ.

experiments.title: Trial 3 conditional teacher downstream baseline
experiments.decision: Verified: all five arms and three matched seeds completed 1,000 successful updates. Requested SR-GDA minus uniform: -0.92 pp; pseudo: +2.17 pp. See all seed results below; this is a descriptive D_val comparison.
experiments.protocol: Same 5k teacher pool and balanced 5k real training set. Prices learned on D_val; all 5k D_val images used for reporting. Public teacher may have seen D_val. Requested weights achieve ESS 0.8001. All pseudo-label prices clip to zero, so those weights only correct class priors; their comparison does not isolate scale pricing. No C_risk, D_test, one-step generator or certificate result.

experiments.title: Trial 1 native conditional initialization
experiments.decision: Verified bounded null result: copied multistep teacher is exact and97.5% accurate; retained one-step student improves fresh accuracy to17.6% vs9.55% reset but misses30% early gate. Both are blurred, recall0; no accepted one-step model or extension.

experiments.title: Two T4s · conditional DMD vs teacher pairs
experiments.decision: Teacher-pair regression has lower FID and slightly higher accuracy in this short screen, but neither passes the frozen joint gates. Teacher preflight accuracy is 97%; student grids repeat across requested classes. Next candidate: preserve pretrained class conditioning in a compatible student initialization. No extension.
experiments.protocol: 200 iterations per T4; 191 / 200 successful G updates; 500 independent label probes. Quality: 2k fresh fake / 5k D_val; Inception pool3; separate 2.5k / 2.5k real-real FID 20.08 (diagnostic, not a floor). Single seed; not directly comparable with historical 8k / 4k FID.
